units.source_text: 于是，白狗阿嗅开始顺着风向，不停的吸溜着鼻子，

en.t: So Ah-Xiu, the white dog, began following the direction of the wind, constantly sniffing with his nose,

units.source_text: 突然抖了一个激灵，说到：“汪汪汪，

en.t: then suddenly shuddered and said, "Woof, woof, woof,

units.source_text: 大公主是被那个住在生驹山洞里的食蜃人抓走的。”

en.t: the eldest princess was carried off by that mirage-eating man who lives in a cave on Mount Ikoma."
